title: [DocDB] Incorrect profile counters in prof_gen build
body:
Jira Link: [DB-4308](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-4308)
### Description

Currently we build prof_gen in `lto=full` mode to get counters from functions from all linked dso's.
And we see that inlined functions are countered as many times as the number of object files where they are inlined into.

To illustrate it, here my_sum is an inline function and is called 2 times - once from bar and once from foo:
```
$ cat foo.cpp
#include "inline.h"

int foo(int n, int m) {
  return my_sum(n, m);
}

int bar(int, int);

int main() {
  int res = foo(4,5) + bar(3,5);
}

$ cat bar.cpp
#include "inline.h"

int bar(int n, int m) {
  return my_sum(n, m);
}

$ cat inline.h 
#pragma once
inline int my_sum(int a, int b){
  return a + b;
}
```

If we compile with `-flto=full` then my_sum will have the counter 4, not 2 as it should be.

```
$ clang++ foo.cpp -c -O3 -g -flto=full -fprofile-instr-generate -stdlib=libc++ -o foo.cpp.o
$ file foo.cpp.o
foo.cpp.o: LLVM IR bitcode
$ clang++ bar.cpp -c -O3 -g -flto=full -fprofile-instr-generate -stdlib=libc++ -o bar.cpp.o
$ clang++ foo.cpp.o bar.cpp.o -O3 -g -flto=full -fprofile-instr-generate -o lto_a.out -fuse-ld=lld -fwhole-program -stdlib=libc++ 
$ ./lto_a.out
$ llvm-profdata show --all-functions default.profraw |c++filt 
Counters:
  foo(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
  my_sum(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 2
  main:
    Hash: 0x0000000000000000
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
  bar(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
  my_sum(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 2
Instrumentation level: Front-end
Functions shown: 5
Total functions: 5
Maximum function count: 2
Maximum internal block count: 0
$ llvm-profdata merge -o merged.profdata default.profraw
$ llvm-profdata show --all-functions merged.profdata |c++filt
Counters:
  my_sum(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 4
  main:
    Hash: 0x0000000000000000
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
  bar(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
  foo(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
Instrumentation level: Front-end
Functions shown: 4
Total functions: 4
Maximum function count: 4
Maximum internal block count: 0
```

To fix this we need to build prof_gen in whole program mode but without lto. Then everything is counted the right way.

```
$ clang++ foo.cpp -c -O3 -g -fprofile-instr-generate -stdlib=libc++ -o foo.cpp.o
$ file foo.cpp.o
foo.cpp.o: ELF 64-bit LSB relocatable, x86-64, version 1 (GNU/Linux), with debug_info, not stripped
$ clang++ bar.cpp -c -O3 -g -fprofile-instr-generate -stdlib=libc++ -o bar.cpp.o
$ clang++ foo.cpp.o bar.cpp.o -O3 -g -fprofile-instr-generate -o lto_a.out -fuse-ld=lld -fwhole-program -stdlib=libc++ 
$ ./lto_a.out
$ llvm-profdata merge -o merged.profdata default.profraw
$ llvm-profdata show --all-functions merged.profdata |c++filt
Counters:
  foo(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
  my_sum(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 2
  main:
    Hash: 0x0000000000000000
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
  bar(int, int):
    Hash: 0x0000000000000018
    Counters: 1
    Function count: 1
Instrumentation level: Front-end
Functions shown: 4
Total functions: 4
Maximum function count: 2
Maximum internal block count: 0
```
